commits.message: fix(docker): remove useless network_mode
Add fields in Ticker structure: High, Low

Handle panic error when the connection with kafka cannot be done.

It adds a new field in tickers: last_update. It is the time of the last update.
It updates the GDAX URL with the new one: Coinbase Proxy.
Adds the service 'romantic-aggregator' in docker-compose file.

Add management of environment variables. Add timer in the aggregator.

Environment variables manage now the name of the kafka topic, the port of the api and the mode of GIN. These variables have been added to the Makefile.

A timer has been added to the aggregator. It sends the current averages of tickers received at regular intervals.
A channel has been added to handle timer modifications. This channel is handled by the api with a new route /timer/{newDuration}, where {newDuration} can be : 1m,3m,5m,15m,30m,45m,1H,2H,3H,4H,1D,1W,1M.

The documentation of the aggregator has been added.
Levels of some logs have been updated.
A timer which calculates the start time has been added.
Add list of exchanges in README

Add aggregrator functions. Add API.

The aggregator calculates a weighted average base on the volume of each currency pairs sent by websockets.
The API has been created to handle subscribe messages. We can now easily subscribe or unsubscribe to a currency.

The interrupt-signal handling has been improved by adding stop functions in each part of the code (aggregator, exchange, kafka...)
The error handling has been improved with the using of juju/errors
The logs system has been improved with the using of sirupsen/logrus

README has been edited.

Manage the subscriptions of each exchanges

We were not able to manage the unsubscriptions because we needed to have some informations about the current subscriptions (ex: chanId in Bitfinex).
To overcome this, we added the management of feedback messages sent by the exchangers during a modification in subscriptions.

The recoverer function presents in the proxy package has been refactored. It uses now the recover function provided by golang.

Refactors exchanges architecture, adds proxy

A new structure has been added: Proxy. Contains the necessary to intermediate between the websockets and the aggregator.
Common functions in each exchanges code (having a link with websockets) have been exported to a new package which contains the Proxy structure.

Finally, a bug have been discovered just after the last commit: when the websockets have nothing to send for a while, they close the connection.
A function have been added to resolve this bug. It recreates a new connection between the aggregator and the websocket.
Initialize the project

fix: rename `path` variable in gwa() to avoid zsh builtin conflict

In zsh, `path` is a special array tied to `PATH`. Using `local path=...`
shadows it and wipes PATH inside the function, causing `git` to not be
found.
